verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime Anne-series novel first-book-publication span, from Anne of Green Gables to Anne of Ingleside, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The eight markers use original English-language book years, not composition, serialization, later translations, reissues, adaptations or fictional chronology. Anne of Green Gables was written in 1905 but published in 1908. Anne of Windy Poplars (1936), issued as Anne of Windy Willows in Britain and Australia, and Anne of Ingleside (1939) fill earlier gaps in Anne’s life despite appearing after Rilla of Ingleside (1921). The Blythes Are Quoted was completed near her death in 1942 but first published in full in 2009, after an abridged 1974 version; it does not extend the lifetime bar. Story collections, including the two Chronicles of Avonlea volumes, novels outside the Anne sequence, poetry, journalism, journals, letters and posthumous releases are excluded.
